# DocPharma

> DocPharma is India's first healthcare quick-commerce supply chain. It runs licensed darkstores, pharmacist validation, AI-driven inventory and its own delivery fleet as one network, so healthcare businesses can deliver medicines and wellness products in about 30 minutes without building that infrastructure themselves.

- Legal entity: Fledge Healthplus Private Limited
- Registered office: A2 306, Azure Tower, MI Central Park, Arjunganj, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh 226001, India
- Coverage: 12+ cities including Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune and Kolkata; 19,000+ pincodes through own riders and partner couriers
- Serves: e-pharmacies, D2C health and wellness brands, corporate wellness platforms, health insurers, doctors and hospitals
- Compliance: drug-licensed fulfilment, prescriptions validated with registered-pharmacist sign-off before dispatch, FSSAI-compliant handling of food and nutrition products, batch/expiry/MRP captured for every unit
- Integrations: Shopify, Unicommerce, EasyEcom, order API with webhook status updates
- Contact: +91 75420 21525, tech-support@fledgehealth.com
